about: Build log of the place london (Greater London, kind blocks) by cwplans/tools/build-place-tiles.mjs: what was fetched (URL, date, SHA-256) and each dataflow activity with its input and output hashes. Raw files stay in cwplans/data/raw/places/london/ (not committed).

overture-buildings.request: DuckDB read_parquet over HTTPS of the 512 files of the release, filter on bbox and: is_underground IS NOT TRUE; columns subtype, class, names.primary, height, num_floors, min_height, roof_shape, has_parts, is_underground; rows ordered by id, one JSON object a line (fetch-overture-theme.py, .ndjson)
overture-buildings.licence: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap-derived records; the record sources list names each source and licence)

as_fetched.note: the query answer as written by cwplans/tools/fetch-overture-theme.py (raw folder, NDJSON); sha256 above

activities.note: outputs under data/raw are intermediate (not committed); their hashes fix the next step

params.rule: as place-heights over the selected buildings: OSM height > OSM building:levels x storey > Overture height > Overture num_floors x storey (non-OSM records, open licence, not Microsoft) > Microsoft ML Buildings height (via Overture; footprint match: a centroid inside the other outline, area ratio >= 0.5) > small kinds 3 m > GHSL cell under the centroid (min 3 m) > default; no roofs (blocks)

activities.note: outputs under data/raw are intermediate (not committed); their hashes fix the next step

inputs.label: world-base heights
inputs.path: docklands/data/world-basedem (77 tiles over the query box; sha256 of the list of path and sha256 of each)

classes: merged buildings (one box a square, turned to the grain of its buildings: the summed footprint, the area-weighted mean height)
